Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. As discussed, we can move HelionTech from direct invoicing to AWS Marketplace (Seller of Record) for the services covered under Contract #45231. The goal here is to simplify procurement for your teams and enable standard marketplace billing and entitlement flows for renewals/expansions.

Quick summary of what we’re proposing:
- Effective switchover date: 2026-12-15 (we can accelerate if you need).
- Financial mechanics: Marketplace will invoice HelionTech and Redwood will mirror entitlements; any overlapping charges during the cutover will be pro-rated and credited.
- Technical/ops: no changes required to your existing usage integration; entitlements will map to the marketplace SKU.

Attached: SOR_Transition_FAQ.pdf (FAQ for procurement/finops) and Amendment_Draft_v1.pdf (paperwork we’d ask you to sign).

Can you confirm:
1) A PO number we should reference for the amendment?
2) Whether 12/15 works as a target production cutover?
3) Any special invoicing fields (company tax ID, remit-to address) for the marketplace invoice?

If that timeline and approach work, I’ll send the DocuSign and loop in Jonas to finalize mapping to your existing commitment/seat setup.

Appreciate it —

Laura Bennett

Hi Sarah / Mike —

Answers inline below and next steps: 

> Will the marketplace invoice include our full company tax ID and remit-to info?
Yes — AWS Marketplace invoices include the customer tax ID and remit-to where provided. If you need a specific vendor number present on our side we can add Redwood vendor references in the amendment notes (not on the marketplace invoice itself). Please send the exact tax ID and remit address and we’ll validate.

> How will December usage be billed? Pro-rated?
We will: 
- Settlement: December usage through 12/14 will be billed on your existing direct invoice cycle (we will short-pay the final direct invoice for the post-12/15 usage).
- Starting 12/15: usage will appear on the AWS Marketplace invoice.
- Reconciliation: We will create a one-time credit for any double-billed or overlapping charges and apply to your January invoice if timing requires.

> Mapping committed seats to marketplace SKUs
Jonas attached the mapping doc. If there are any custom SKUs on your side, please flag them; we can create an entitlement alias during the migration.

DocuSign: I’ve prepared the packet — link here: https://www.docusign.net/HelionTech_SOR_Amendment_22A7
Please sign the amendment and reply with PO_45231 (or the confirmed PO number) so we can finalize the effective switchover.

Next steps (proposed):
1) HelionTech signs DocuSign by Mon 12/06.
2) Redwood and AWS verify SKU entitlements by Tue 12/07.
3) Switchover 12/15; monitoring window through 12/20.

If that cadence works I’ll notify Legal and Finance to prepare the credit runbook.
